messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up  we need a concise GA clearance for Launch X. Core checklist: SLA targets, docs + runbooks, oncall rota, monitoring dashboards, and billing/quota mapping. Propose: hosted P99 <= 300ms for payloads <=512 tokens, availability >= 99.9%, canary + billing smoke.

Zane (SRE): Quick clarifying Q: does P99 300ms apply across all models or just the default rwd-v1?

Maya (PM): For GA initial scope it applies to default rwd-v1 serving path only. We'll call out other models as "out of scope" for strict SLA in docs.

Priya (Eng): Canaries are green on staging. I'll add a production canary job and a short smoke script into runbooks. Need SRE to confirm alert thresholds.

Zane (SRE): Proposed alerts:
- perf.p99 > 300ms for 5m -> Sev2
- error.rate > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 30m -> Exec page
I'll update rotation for first 72h post-launch.

Diego (FinOps): Billing items: quota to rate card mapping missing for pilot tiers. Also want an automated billing smoke flow: create org, run small sample (1k tokens), assert invoice emitted and webhook fired. Who wires the test harness?

Maya (PM): Owners: Zane -> alerts & oncall; Priya -> canary + runbook snippet; Diego -> billing mapping + smoke harness; Maya -> signoff doc and exec notification.

Priya (Eng): Smoke script (to include in runbook):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"hi"}' | jq .status
```
Will run it against the canary endpoint and then prod after deploy.

Diego (FinOps): I'll prepare test org creds and the expected invoice JSON. Will run billing smoke pre- and post-deploy and post results here.

Zane (SRE): Oncall: recommend Priya+Zane cover first 72h; platform oncall takes over after 2 weeks. Need confirmation so I can block calendar.

Maya (PM): Confirmed. I'll update the oncall calendar and the launch timeline.

OncallBot: Reminder: runbook for Launch X: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/launch-x (contains canary checklist).

Priya (Eng): Docs: adding "Launch X GA expectations" section listing SLA table, limitations (long sequences), smoke steps, rollback triggers. ETA 5 hrs.

Diego (FinOps): Billing doc ETA 2 hrs; including webhook sample and sample invoice event: invoice.generated.v1.

Zane (SRE): I'll coordinate a 30-min live canary window during the deploy and watch p99. If stable, I'll flip alerts from staging to active.

Maya (PM): Action summary for signoff doc:
- SLA: hosted P99 <= 300ms (<=512 tokens) and availability >=99.9% (owner: Maya)
- Alerts + oncall coverage (owner: Zane)
- Canary & smoke script (owner: Priya)
- Billing smoke + quota mapping (owner: Diego)
- Docs + runbook + limitations (owner: Priya)
- Final signoff thread (owner: Maya)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept. No objections by 18:00 PT -> proceed with launch tomorrow.

Priya (Eng): :thumbsup:

Zane (SRE): :thumbsup:

Diego (FinOps): :thumbsup: will post billing run results shortly

Maya (PM): Thanks  I'll assemble the formal signoff and ping execs once tests pass.
